item.title: How are the Wisconsin Lottery drawings conducted for Lotto games? | Wisconsin Lottery Wisconsin Lottery
item.description: How are the Wisconsin Lottery drawings conducted for Lotto games? pete.capp Wed, 12/19/2018 - 17:00 How are the Wisconsin Lottery drawings conducted? All Wisconsin Lottery games are drawn using a Random Number Generator (RNG). A RNG is a machine with the sole purpose of picking random numbers. It is not connected to any outside line or to the Lottery gaming system. Lotto Game Drawings RNG 1000

item.description: Why does it seem like all the winners are coming from a specific area of the state? pete.capp Wed, 12/19/2018 - 17:03 Why does it seem like all the winners are coming from a specific area of the state? Wisconsin Lottery winning tickets are distributed randomly. We have no control over who wins or where the winner is from. Areas in Wisconsin with higher populations tend to have more retailers.
